fields.name: name
fields.description: The identifier or designation for the related item.

events.name: RelatedItemLoaded
events.description: Signals that related items have been successfully loaded.

events.name: RelatedItemLoadFailed
events.description: Indicates failure to load related items.

events.name: SELECT_RELATED
events.description: Signals a related item was selected to drive a detail view.

events.name: SHOW_RELATED
events.description: Scopes the related fetch to rows whose relationField equals key.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Which field labels each related row?
overridableConfigKeys.description: Name of the field on the (rebound) related row rendered as the row label and carried as SELECT_RELATED's name — set it to `title` (etc.) whenever the bound entity labels rows differently. The rows are mapped through this at render time, because a trait-level `fields {}` rename is declaration-only on the runtime path and every populated row used to render a blank label.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Relation field
overridableConfigKeys.description: RelatedItem field compared against SHOW_RELATED's key to scope the fetch to one parent document; empty renders the full unfiltered collection (default).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Table look
overridableConfigKeys.description: Layer 2 visual treatment for the data table rendered by this atom.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Section title
overridableConfigKeys.description: Heading shown above the related list.
